status: prespecified before any permutation run; no value changes afterwards; a change needs p3_protocol_v2 and a log note

eval_cell.dataset_config: p2_primary_v1 (hardware on, continuous stiffness, eta_by_stage on)

permutation.control: same architecture and training protocol as the real model, trained on the real model's training windows with labels randomly permuted (one permutation per control)
permutation.statistic: accuracy of a model on the 300-window evaluation cell at a depth (stored as correct count out of 300)
permutation.p_value: (count of controls with accuracy >= real accuracy + 1) / (B + 1)
permutation.pooled_null: rejected: control accuracy spread depends on depth (data/null_depth_dependence_check.txt)
deviations: ResNet1D N=10 instead of 24 (allowed by the brief)
ResNet1D B=199 instead of 719 (B+1=200 < 720); needed to keep the total at about 36 h; see PROTOCOL.md

decision_rule.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg at q=0.05 across the 36 depths of one evaluation
decision_rule.new_floor: scan from 0 cm outward; the floor is the last depth before the first run of 2 consecutive non-significant depths; no such run => right-censored at 20 cm and flagged; if depth 0 starts the run the floor is set to 0.0 and flagged start_nonsignificant; no interpolation
decision_rule.old_rule: first non-significant depth in the scan, or 20 cm (censored) if none; computed on the same p-values
decision_rule.classwise_safety_floor: first depth at which any class recall of the real model is below 0.45 at that depth and the next depth; none => censored at 20 cm

summaries.unit: per-seed floor = median over K draws (a grid depth when K is even and the two middle values coincide, else the mean of the two middle grid depths, flagged); also pooled seed x draw values
summaries.bootstrap: resample seeds with replacement, 10000 replicates, percentile intervals
summaries.variance_decomposition: one-way random effects F[seed,draw]: seed component, draw-within-seed component, plus a fixed grid-discretization component mean(step^2)/12 over consecutive grid steps; balanced ANOVA estimators, negatives set to 0 and reported, REML cross-check, bootstrap over seeds; with and without censored floors

rng: every stream is zlib.crc32 of a string key; no Python hash()
